sections.title: Dell XPS 15
content: ¿Cansado de que la batería de tu portátil se agote rápidamente? El Dell XPS 15 resuelve este problema con baterías energéticamente eficientes y soporte de carga rápida, perfecto para aquellos que dependen de su laptop todo el día. Conéctate fácilmente a lo que amas gracias al software ComfortView, reduciendo la emisión de luz azul para proteger tus ojos durante largas horas de trabajo.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1699 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Effortlessly chic. Always efficient. Finish your to-do list in no time with the Dell 15, built for everyday computing with Intel Core i5 processor.
Designed for easy learning: Energy-efficient batteries and Express Charge support extend your focus and productivity.

Stay connected to what you love: Spend more screen time on the things you enjoy with Dell ComfortView software that helps reduce harmful blue light emissions to keep your eyes comfortable over extended viewing times.
Type with ease: Write and calculate quickly with roomy keypads, separate numeric keypad and calculator hotkey.
Ergonomic support: Keep your wrists comfortable with lifted hinges that provide an ergonomic typing angle.

sections.title: HP ZBook Firefly
content: -Portable- diseño y carga rápida son la esencia del HP ZBook Firefly. Con solo 3.13 libras, su portátil rendimiento ultraportátil redefine la productividad sobre la marcha. La certificación ISV asegura funcionalidad impecable para aplicaciones críticas como AutoCAD y MATLAB, potenciando cada proyecto sin esfuerzo.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1100 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: PORTABLE AND COMPATIBLE DESIGN - The HP ZBook Firefly 14 G11 Mobile Workstation combines pro-level performance with a portable design to enhance your work-anywhere experience. Weighing only 3.13 lbs, meeting MIL-STD 810H standards, and featuring a 56Whr battery with fast charging (up to 50% in 30 mins), it’s an essential tool for professionals. Certifications from Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) ensure smooth operation of critical apps like AutoCAD, CREO, SolidWorks, ANSYS, and MATLAB

PREMIUM PERFORMANCE - Powered by the Intel Core Ultra 7 165U processor (10 cores, up to 4.9 GHz) and Intel graphics for superior AI performance, creativity, and multitasking. It also features 32GB DDR5 RAM and 1TB SSD for fast storage and reduced load times, seamless management of large datasets, and responsive operation for all your tasks

PROFESSIONAL DISPLAY - The laptop features a 14" WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS display, coupled with 300-nit brightness and anti-glare technology for vibrant and comfortable viewing. It supports expanding the workspace with 3 external monitors via HDMI or Thunderbolt 4, with a maximum resolution of up to 4K@60Hz, without a docking station. Plus, a 5MP IR webcam with privacy shutter for facial recognition and clear video calls

RICH CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS - Stay connected with versatile ports, including 2x Thunderbolt 4, 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1, HDMI 2.1, and a headphone/microphone combo jack. Enjoy blazing-fast wireless speeds with Intel Wi-Fi 6E and seamless device pairing via Bluetooth 5.3. Enhance security and convenience with a built-in fingerprint reader and work comfortably in any lighting with a backlit keyboard

OPERATING SYSTEM - Windows 11 Pro 64-bit, with AI-powered Copilot, offers intelligent assistance for a variety of tasks. Ideal for Designers, Architects, Photographers, Video editors, Engineers, Gaming, Professionals, Programmers, Streaming, Businesses, etc

sections.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X1
content: -Lo que no te dicen- del Lenovo ThinkPad X1 es su opción táctil que transforma tu experiencia visual a otro nivel. Con un impresionante display IPS FHD+, cada detalle cobra vida mientras disfrutas de una navegación fluida y colorida.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1992 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon features the Ultra 7 255U processor with speeds up to 5.2GHz and 12MB cache, ensuring smooth multitasking and smart AI optimization. This X1 Carbon gen 13 laptop comes with 32GB DDR5 RAM for fast processing and a 1TB SSD PCIe for ultra-fast storage. Built for business professionals, students, and remote workers.

IMMERSIVE TOUCH DISPLAY: Enjoy an immersive viewing experience with the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Touchscreen FHD+ 14-inch (1920x1200) IPS display, delivering crisp visuals and accurate colors. The Integrated Intel Graphics enhances performance for streaming, presentations, and daily computing. Whether for business, school, or entertainment, this 14-inch laptop is optimized for clarity, brightness, and productivity, making it perfect for students and professionals.

KEYBOARD & CONNECTIVITY: The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon features 2 x USB-C (Thunderbolt 4), 2 x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 (USB 5Gbps, 1x always on), 1 x HDMI 2.1 (up to 4K/60Hz), 1 x Audio jack (3.5mm), Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, Fingerprint Reader, Backlit Keyboard, FHD 1080p + IR Webcam with Privacy Shutter.
WARRANTY & DURABILITY: The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 is backed by a 1-Year Lenovo Warranty & 1-Year Oem genuine Limited Warranty, ensuring peace of mind. See the product description for details.
